profile.name: Data Analyst Portfolio Website
profile.tagline: Turning complex data into clear, actionable insights.
about: I am a data analyst based in Sandton, South Africa, working across financial markets and lead analytics.

I turn raw, fragmented data into clear and actionable insight. My work covers the full path from data to decision: sourcing and preparing the data, carrying out the analysis, and delivering the result as dashboards and data solutions that teams can act on. The objective is always business value — sharper priorities, stronger conversion, and decisions supported by evidence.

My background in web development means I do not stop at the analysis. I build the dashboards and tools that put insight in front of the people who need it. I am currently focused on applying AI within these data solutions to improve the speed and accuracy with which insight reaches the business.

projects.title: Customer Lifetime Value & Churn Prediction
projects.summary: Customer-level model for deciding who is worth keeping.
projects.description: Built a model that scores every telecommunications customer on what they are worth and how likely they are to leave. Established a rule that weighs the value saved against the cost of a retention offer, separating customers worth contacting from those to leave alone.

projects.title: SME Capital Funding Optimization
projects.summary: Data-driven capital matching model for SMEs.
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive model to analyze SME applicant data from the JSE's SME Capital Matching Campaign into tiers determining each SMEs viablilty to be recieve capital funding from investors. Provided recommedations on strategies on to optimize conversion rate on SME recieving capital funding.

projects.title: Demand & Revenue Insights Console
projects.summary: Self-updating tracker consolidating campaign leads and revenue.
projects.description: Built a self-updating tracker that consolidates daily leads and revenue from campaigns run across multiple divisions. Replaced scattered, manually maintained spreadsheets with a single, date-anchored source of info for tracking and analysing campaign performance.

projects.title: Sunsetting Procedure Console
projects.summary: Page-level tracking system for a website content audit.
projects.description: Built a tracking system that records the outcome of a website content audit at page level, assigning every URL a named custodian, a sunsetting decision, a reason and a date. Established a single auditable record of ownership and decisions across the site.
